svg.aria-label: Projects: Dispatch Management: Work order → packing → loading → gate pass.; Job Lens: 100 resumes in. A ranked shortlist out.; KioskSentinel: Attendance that survives power cuts.; Test Planner: Every IEC 60076 test, scheduled.; Hardware Platform v1.3: Hardware PDF in, weighted BOM out.; Intelligent Street Lighting: A light bubble that follows the car.; RTCC & M.Box Tracker: Chases pending points so nobody has to.; Industrial Data System: QR-tagged test data + a 3D transformer.; HWE Automation Tool: Feeder classes, loads and I/O in one click.; Flood Alerting System: Rising water, instant alerts.
